title: Dashboard metric tiles: the title wraps or the measure label yields before the title truncates to three letters
body:
## Source

Walked on objectui main `8415d9f11` at 1024 px: Sales Performance (`/dashboard/sales_dashboard`) draws its four KPI tiles as "Tot… Total Amount", "Clo… Total Amount", "Op… Opportunities", "Av… Avg Deal Size"; Executive Overview does the same ("Total … Total Amount", "Active A… Accounts"). After objectui#12528 / #12573 the tile's first line holds the title and the measure label side by side; in a 150 px tile the measure label keeps its width and the title is cut to two or three letters, so a row of KPIs reads as nonsense.

## Target

1. The title owns the first line (13 px / 500, up to two lines with an ellipsis on the second); the measure label moves to a 11 px muted line under the value, and is dropped below 160 px tile width (it stays in the tooltip).
2. The value never wraps; it shrinks one step (24 → 20 px) below 160 px.
3. The same rule in the Sales Home page's KPI blocks, which share the tile.

## File surface

`packages/plugin-dashboard/src/` metric tile (the dataset-bound tile and the plain one), tests beside.

## Acceptance

1. Tests: at a 150 px width the title text is complete and the measure label is absent; at 240 px both show.
2. Screenshots of Sales Performance at 1024 and 1280 px.
3. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-dashboard test` green.

## Evidence

Screenshots on the temporary branch `claude/console-home-login-design-20261016` of objectstack-ai/objectui (commit `b72c97985`, never merged): [hotcrm-sales-performance-tiles-truncated.jpg](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/b72c97985/docs/design/hotcrm-review-2026-10-16/hotcrm-sales-performance-tiles-truncated.jpg?raw=true).

<sub>Filed by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` from the 2026-10-16 walk of HotCRM's core pages as a user: objectui main `8415d9f11`, HotCRM `63db83e2`, the vite console on :5180 against `objectstack serve --dev` on :4001, the maintainer's browser pane at 1024 × 768 (en). The maintainer asked for the findings to be filed on the repository each belongs to, verbatim: 「相关问题也在对应的项目上创建任务」.</sub>
